Solomon Islands
Consular help: Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Canberra, Australia.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens (Visa shell be issued in Belgrade):
Regular passport YES
Regular biometric passport YES
Service/Official biometric passport YES
Diplomatic biometric passport YES
Citizens of the Solomon Islands are exempted from the obligation to obtain a visa for entry, exit, transit and stay on the territory of Bosnia and Herzegovina up to ninety (90) days in any period of a hundred and eighty (180) days, which means taking into account the period of a hundred and eighty (180) days preceding each day of a stay. Visa shall be issued in Canberra, Australia.
